  • Constructor Details

    • LeadingConstraintEvidence

      private LeadingConstraintEvidence(ProcessModelOperatingEnvelopeStudy.LeadingConstraintEvidence.Source source, String qualifiedConstraintName, double normalizedUtilization, double normalizedMargin, double currentValue, double applicableLimit, double physicalMargin, String physicalUnit, boolean feasible, String diagnostic, String applicableLimitRole, String applicableLimitProvenance)
      Creates immutable leading-constraint evidence.
      Parameters:
      source - evidence layer
      qualifiedConstraintName - stable constraint identity
      normalizedUtilization - dimensionless utilization
      normalizedMargin - dimensionless remaining margin
      currentValue - sampled physical value
      applicableLimit - applicable physical limit
      physicalMargin - signed physical headroom
      physicalUnit - engineering unit
      feasible - whether the selected evidence is feasible
      diagnostic - concise diagnostic
      applicableLimitRole - role or basis of the applicable limit
      applicableLimitProvenance - applicable-limit provenance
